task_description: Row-sum of a 128x128 bf16 array, comparing a per-lane Python accumulation loop (128 single-lane reads+adds) against one jnp.sum(axis=1) call.

metrics.name: num_reduce_ops
metrics.description: number of distinct reduction-related VMEM read/accumulate operations issued. Naive: N (one per column). Optimized: 1. Exact and verifiable from the code alone, same convention as 03_vectorized_vmem/config.json.

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: secondary/confirmatory signal, same convention as other cells. This cell is bandwidth/overhead-bound, not compute-bound -- num_reduce_ops is the more direct signal.

note: This row also covers prefix-scan / cumulative reductions (e.g. a log-space cumsum used to build a decay mask, as in RetNet/Mamba2-style attention variants in JAXBench) -- see guide.md's 'Prefix scans' section. Not a separate cell: same underlying principle (native op vs. manual loop), different JAX primitive (jnp.cumsum vs. jnp.sum).
